scene.label: Act 4, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Florence. A room in the Widow's house.
scene.location: Florence. A room in the Widow's house.

lines.text: That you may well perceive I have not wrong'd you
lines.plainText: That you may well perceive I have not wrong'd you

lines.text: One of the greatest in the Christian world
lines.plainText: One of the greatest in the Christian world

lines.text: Shall be my surety; fore whose throne 'tis needful,
lines.plainText: Shall be my surety fore whose throne 'tis needful

lines.text: Ere I can perfect mine intents, to kneel.
lines.plainText: Ere I can perfect mine intents to kneel

lines.text: Time was I did him a desired office,
lines.plainText: Time was I did him a desired office

lines.text: Dear almost as his life; which gratitude
lines.plainText: Dear almost as his life which gratitude

lines.text: Through flinty Tartar's bosom would peep forth,
lines.plainText: Through flinty Tartar's bosom would peep forth

lines.text: And answer thanks. I duly am inform'd
lines.plainText: And answer thanks I duly am inform'd

lines.text: His grace is at Marseilles; to which place
lines.plainText: His grace is at Marseilles to which place

lines.text: We have convenient convoy. You must know
lines.plainText: We have convenient convoy You must know

lines.text: I am supposed dead. The army breaking,
lines.plainText: I am supposed dead The army breaking

lines.text: My husband hies him home, where, heaven aiding,
lines.plainText: My husband hies him home where heaven aiding

lines.text: And by the leave of my good lord the king,
lines.plainText: And by the leave of my good lord the king

lines.text: We'll be before our welcome.
lines.plainText: We'll be before our welcome

lines.text: Gentle madam,
lines.plainText: Gentle madam

lines.text: You never had a servant to whose trust
lines.plainText: You never had a servant to whose trust

lines.text: Your business was more welcome.
lines.plainText: Your business was more welcome

lines.text: Nor you, mistress,
lines.plainText: Nor you mistress

lines.text: Ever a friend whose thoughts more truly labour
lines.plainText: Ever a friend whose thoughts more truly labour

lines.text: To recompense your love. Doubt not but heaven
lines.plainText: To recompense your love Doubt not but heaven

lines.text: Hath brought me up to be your daughter's dower,
lines.plainText: Hath brought me up to be your daughter's dower

lines.text: As it hath fated her to be my motive
lines.plainText: As it hath fated her to be my motive

lines.text: And helper to a husband. But, O strange men!
lines.plainText: And helper to a husband But O strange men

lines.text: That can such sweet use make of what they hate,
lines.plainText: That can such sweet use make of what they hate

lines.text: When saucy trusting of the cozen'd thoughts
lines.plainText: When saucy trusting of the cozen'd thoughts

lines.text: Defiles the pitchy night; so lust doth play
lines.plainText: Defiles the pitchy night so lust doth play

lines.text: With what it loathes, for that which is away.
lines.plainText: With what it loathes for that which is away

lines.text: But more of this hereafter. You, Diana,
lines.plainText: But more of this hereafter You Diana

lines.text: Under my poor instructions yet must suffer
lines.plainText: Under my poor instructions yet must suffer

lines.text: Something in my behalf.
lines.plainText: Something in my behalf

lines.text: Let death and honesty
lines.plainText: Let death and honesty

lines.text: Go with your impositions, I am yours
lines.plainText: Go with your impositions I am yours

lines.text: Upon your will to suffer.
lines.plainText: Upon your will to suffer

lines.text: Yet, I pray you;
lines.plainText: Yet I pray you

lines.text: But with the word the time will bring on summer,
lines.plainText: But with the word the time will bring on summer

lines.text: When briers shall have leaves as well as thorns,
lines.plainText: When briers shall have leaves as well as thorns

lines.text: And be as sweet as sharp. We must away;
lines.plainText: And be as sweet as sharp We must away

lines.text: Our waggon is prepar'd, and time revives us.
lines.plainText: Our waggon is prepar'd and time revives us

lines.text: All's well that ends well; still the fine's the crown.
lines.plainText: All's well that ends well still the fine's the crown

lines.text: Whate'er the course, the end is the renown.
lines.plainText: Whate'er the course the end is the renown
